hero.h1: Amps, cabs, pedals and NAM captures in one free app for your Mac.
hero.lede: {gear} pieces of gear, from a Marshall 1959 SLP to a Tube Screamer, played through the audio interface you already own.
hero.note: No account, no subscription, nothing locked behind a paywall.
hero.caption: One project, three chains: lead guitar split between a Marshall and an AC30, rhythm through a Twin Reverb, acoustic on its own.
footer.tagline: Free and open-source guitar rig for macOS.
